**You can apply for the following open research grants (all meet the CGPA ≥ 8.0 requirement for a final‑year ENTC student):**

| Grant code | Title | Application deadline | Status |
|------------|-------------------------------|-------------------|--------|
| GR‑IOT‑07 | Smart Campus IoT Research Grant | 20 Jan 2027 | open |
| GR‑5G‑15 | 5G and Next‑Gen Networks Fellowship | 31 Jan 2027 | open |
| GR‑VLSI‑09 | VLSI Design Research Fellowship | 10 Feb 2027 | open |
| GR‑SUS‑08 | Sustainability & Green Computing Grant | 28 Feb 2027 | open |
| GR‑ENT‑13 | Student Startup Seed Grant | 01 Mar 2027 | open |

*Eligibility proof* – Your CGPA 8.2 ≥ 8.0 satisfies the minimum for GR‑IOT‑07, GR‑5G‑15, GR‑VLSI‑09, GR‑SUS‑08, and GR‑ENT‑13 ([Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026‑27 §3] for each grant). Year 4 and ENTC department are also required and match your profile.

*Status & deadlines* – All five grants are listed as **open** with the shown deadlines in the Grants Register ([SQL]).

**Note:** A student may hold at most **two** research grants simultaneously ([Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026‑27 §2]). Plan which two align best with your interests before the respective deadlines.
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, application_deadline, status FROM grants WHERE grant_code IN ('GR-ENT-13', 'GR-5G-15', 'GR-VLSI-09', 'GR-SUS-08', 'GR-HW-06', 'GR-IOT-07', 'GR-ROB-12') ORDER BY application_deadline LIMIT 50
